ORIGIN.quote: 3,103 label values occur in revisions; 1,082 contain “Agent,” 577 “OpenAI,” and 5 “ChatGPT.” These self-reported names are not model provenance.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader learns that hundreds of agent labels carry the string "OpenAI" and that the report's own view is that such names cannot establish where the agents came from, so the origin question is raised only to be closed off. This sits above the 0.2 band because the report does comment on what the OpenAI-bearing labels imply for provenance rather than merely listing them, but below 0.6 because OpenAI is never left standing as a live candidate operator — the sole remark is a dismissal, and no later passage revisits sponsorship or deployment origin.
